answer_1.quote: Machine translation (MT) users and developers have long exploited the idea that some texts are easier to translate than others.
answer_1.outputs: translation outputs from English to other languages

answer_2.quote: We use XCOMET and METRICX to evaluate different aspects of rewrite quality. Specifically, we use XCOMET-XL 5 and METRICX-23-XL.

answer_4.quote: We use Qualtrics to design our survey and Prolific to recruit human annotators fluent in the tested target language.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are first provided with two translations and asked to evaluate on three axes: 1) Fluency, 2) Understandability, and 3) Level of detail. Subsequently, we provide the reference translation, and annotators are asked to assess 4) Meaning preservation.
